title: Skin Cancer Checks
desc: Thorough skin examinations, mole mapping, and minor surgical procedures for early detection and treatment.
detail: Australia has one of the highest rates of skin cancer in the world. Our experienced GPs perform full-body skin checks, and where needed, can arrange minor surgical removal of suspicious lesions.
fullDesc: Australia has one of the highest rates of skin cancer in the world, making regular skin checks essential. Our GPs, including Dr Essam Botros who holds a Certificate in Dermoscopy and Primary Skin Cancer Surgery, offer thorough full-body skin examinations using dermoscopy equipment. Early detection dramatically improves outcomes, and we can perform minor surgical removal of suspicious lesions in-clinic when required.
